Dr. Shikha Gupta – Physiotherapy Expert

Physiotherapist (20+ yrs) | Official Sports Physio | Fit India Ambassador | CEO, IRSF | President & International Women Awardee

Welcome to the official channel of Dr. Shikha Gupta,a highly experienced physiotherapist with over 20 yrs in clinical & sports rehabilitation. With experience in both Govt & Private hospitals,she specializes in pain management,injury prevention,performance enhancement,& structured rehabilitation.

She serves as the Official Sports Physiotherapist for the Handball Federation of India,Karate India Organisation,Kettlebell Sport India Association,Field Archery Association of India, & Indian Rope Skipping Federation.

On this channel, you’ll find exercise tutorials for mobility & strength,guidance on Frozen Shoulder,Back Pain & Sciatica, rehab for ligament injuries, manual therapy awareness, & exercise management for diabetes-related joint & nerve issues.

Subscribe and begin your journey toward a healthier, pain-free life.
